## INPUTS

- Rule: minute used = the last COMPLETED ZN 1-minute bar at the bar known time (minute start + 60 s <= floor(known time to whole seconds)); r1 = ZN close / ZN close one minute earlier - 1 (NaN if either missing or the contract id changed inside the window); sigma = std (ddof 1) of that series over the 4,320 grid minutes before the minute (>= 600 valid values, current minute excluded); z = value / sigma; NaN counts as 0. UP = z >= +1.0, DN = z <= -1.0, each an EDGE over the whole bar series of ALL sessions. WITH (not against): LONG on the UP edge (ZN rose sharply = z >= +1.0), SHORT on the DN edge. Signals only from NY PM bars (code 4) with part = 0; order time = floor(known second) + 2 s; events at or after 16:00:00 ET dropped. The first row is the preceding bar of the series (earlier session) that carries the edge state.
- DATA END: the ZN 1-minute file on the box ends 2026-11-10 07:59 UTC (last minute start), i.e. before the NY PM session of 20261110: z is NaN for those bars (counts as 0): no signal can occur on td 20261110 from this file. A live ZN feed is required to test the book on that day.
